subject: Vendr portal credentialing rollback — evidence ownership confirmation & upload window
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@bluegrove.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: security@bluegrove.com
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal credentialing — upload failures and rollback

Hi Camila,

Quick heads-up — our security tooling flagged a set of uploads from your Vendr service account yesterday that failed schema validation. Our portal team rolled back the Vendr claim while we investigate to avoid orphaned artifacts.

Before we re-grant access we need confirmation of two things:
1) Who at Redwood is the canonical owner for the evidence upload (name + email).
2) A short manifest of the account(s)/service account(s) that will be used and their intended upload window.

We also need an audit-log extract showing previous upload attempts (time range: 2028-05-25 to 2028-05-29) and the principal used. If you can provide the manifest and the audit excerpt we can re-open claim/permissions.

We can support a short presigned upload window once ownership and the manifest are confirmed — typical process is a 1–2 hour window with a temporary service account and limited S3 presign scope.

Attached: (1) BlueGrove validation summary (CSV snippet) — showing failure rows.

Thanks,
Lina Park
Security Operations — BlueGrove
[Attachment: bluegrove-validation-snippet.csv (CSV)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@bluegrove.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal credentialing — upload failures and rollback

Lina, thanks for the alert and the snippet — appreciate the quick callout.

Short answers up front:
- Canonical owner: Camila Reyes (camila@redwood-inference.com) — Vendor Security Onboarding lead.
- Intended principal: vendr-service-acc@redwood-inference.com (we control this service account, currently delegated to the Vendr connector).

Background/context: last month we delegated a constrained service account to Vendr to perform bulk Whistic/CAIQ imports into your portal. We ran a small dry-run on 2028-05-25 that showed a couple schema mismatches for optional fields (attachment size vs field length) which we patched locally — however it looks like one of the patched pipelines attempted a full rehydrate and hit the portal validation rules. That likely triggered your rollback.

What we will provide by EOD:
- Manifest: redwood_vendr_access_manifest.pdf (attached) — lists service account ARN/email, key expiry, and intended object prefixes.
- Audit excerpt: a small export from our upload worker logs (times 2028-05-25 through 2028-05-29) — will include request ids and principal.
- CAIQ -> SOC2 mapping: short matrix inline below for quick triage.

Proposed remediation flow:
1) BlueGrove confirms owner (Camila) and accepts temporary service account caveats.
2) Redwood requests a 2-hour presign window; we will limit to the provided prefixes.
3) We perform a monitored pass and validate on our side before final push.

CAIQ -> SOC2 quick mapping (high level):
- CAIQ:Network/Boundary Protection -> SOC2:Common Criteria: logical access controls (CC6)
- CAIQ:Data Encryption -> SOC2:Encryption at rest/in transit controls
- CAIQ:AuthZ/AuthN -> SOC2:User access management

Requested upload windows (pick one):
- Option A: 2028-06-02 16:00–18:00 UTC
- Option B: 2028-06-03 02:00–04:00 UTC (low-traffic)

Attaching manifest now. If you prefer we can create a temporary different service account rather than re-using vendr-service-acc; let us know which you prefer and we’ll provision and share keys via your secure channel.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Vendor Security Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_vendr_access_manifest.pdf (PDF)]

From: Lina Park <lina@bluegrove.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: BlueGrove Onboarding <onboard@bluegrove.com>, security@bluegrove.com
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal credentialing — upload failures and rollback

On Tue, May 30, 2028 at 11:03 AM Camila Reyes <camila@redwood-inference.com> wrote:
> Lina, thanks for the alert and the snippet — appreciate the quick callout.
> 
> Short answers up front:
> - Canonical owner: Camila Reyes (camila@redwood-inference.com) — Vendor Security Onboarding lead.
> - Intended principal: vendr-service-acc@redwood-inference.com (we control this service account, currently delegated to the Vendr connector).

Thanks Camila — that helps. We can open a presigned window but need two confirmations before the window:
1) BlueGrove needs a CSV of exact filenames/prefixes you will write (so we can pre-provision object ACL templates).
2) You must confirm whether you want us to re-assign an existing portal claim back to Vendr or to issue a short-lived delegated upload token to a new temporary service account.

We are available to run the window on 2028-06-02 16:00–18:00 UTC (Option A) — please confirm final owner + prefix CSV by 2028-06-01 18:00 UTC.

Also attaching our minimal presign policy and a short checklist for Whistic->Vendr imports (schema expectations). Please include the SOC2 scope you intend to cover (which controls you expect to assert) so our portal team can attach correct metadata to the profile.

Regards,
Lina Park
Security Operations — BlueGrove
[Attachment: bluegrove-presign-policy.txt, bluegrove-whistic-import-checklist.md]

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@bluegrove.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com>, BlueGrove Onboarding <onboard@bluegrove.com>
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal credentialing — upload failures and rollback

Thanks — confirming the run for Option A: 2028-06-02 16:00–18:00 UTC (we accept).

Action items and owners (summary):
- Camila (owner): confirm final prefix CSV and provide audit excerpt (we will attach the audit export to this thread before EOD 2028-05-31).
- Mina (internal): provision a temporary service account if BlueGrove prefers not to re-grant vendr-service-acc; Mina will post the short-lived principal and key fingerprint to your secure onboarding channel.
- Karthik (internal): will run a preflight validation of the CSV against BlueGrove checklist and report back with any schema mismatches by 2028-06-01 12:00 UTC.

Inline: CAIQ->SOC2 field mapping (detailed bullet version):
- network/firewall (CAIQ): maps to SOC2:CC6.1/CC6.2 — we will tag evidence as "network-boundary".
- encryption (CAIQ): maps to SOC2:CC5.x — evidence will include KMS key ARN and encryption algorithm.
- authn/authz (CAIQ): maps to SOC2:CC7.x — evidence will be user lists and role assignment screenshots and recent change log.

Attached export: bluegrove_whistic-export-20280529.csv (this is the trimmed Whistic export we will import — includes file names we plan to write to your portal). We have removed PII columns per your onboarding checklist.

Please confirm whether BlueGrove will re-assign the existing Vendr claim or issue a new temporary upload token. If you want Redwood to run the import on the temporary account, confirm the secure channel you prefer for key exchange (we recommend your org's vault or an SFTP escrow).

We will standby and finalize once you confirm. Thanks — Camila

Camila Reyes
Vendor Security Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0142
[Attachment: bluegrove_whistic-export-20280529.csv (CSV)]
